translations.web: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?
translations.bsb: “Why are you troubled,” Jesus asked, “and why do doubts arise in your hearts?
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?
translations.asv: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and wherefore do questionings arise in your heart?
